notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi guys, Chuckle Phrase Builder has been updated. Here are the main features : 

[list]
[*]Thermoball : As the game progresses, cards with more holes are often selected. The Big Ball is only possible at the end of the game.
[*]There are now 179 text cards and 110 Verb cards. More are too come !
[/list]

If you need to find partners, visit the discord, if you want to submit some card ideas, come to discord !

notes.title: Update May 2021
notes.content:
New update : 
- game name change : "World of LOL" is the name, since "LOL" was bad for referencing. Indeed LOL is very generic and then the gamer would be hard to find by searching the title name. Furthermore, it is also the abbreviated of "League of Legend" game, which is very famous. Keeping this title would be fighting without hope of victory...
- new cards : Crossbreeding, Great reset, Booze, .... and others to make more fun sentences !
- all the cards have now a rarity label which can be of 4 types : Common (green), Rare (Blue), Epic (Orange) and Legendary (Red) based on their potential. The principle is that cards with higher rarity are more difficult to get by spinning the wheel.

What's next ? The plan is now to make localisation available for spanish, german, portuguese and maybe other langages. Since I am not a good practician of those langages, I don't know yet if it is possible to do it for World of LOL without getting too many weird structure of sentences.

I have several questions about the release date, please note that the game will be available when I will get enough people in the whishlist. I don't want to release the game if there is not enough people because since it is multiplayer only, it may fail hard. Sicne the game is free, don't hesitate to talk about it around you !
